text: Why does bisection require an expectation at each checkpoint?
choices: Because the debugger needs a breakpoint condition
Because the compiler cannot check intermediate values
Without a prediction there is no way to judge whether the state at that point is correct
Because otherwise the halving is not exact
explanation: Bisection is not 'look at values and see if they seem odd'. It is 'I expect 500 elements sorted ascending; are there 500 and are they sorted?' This is why the technique fails for people who cannot say what their program should contain at intermediate stages.
